topic: Turning on a Sleep Focus so notifications stay quiet overnight
headline: A Quiet Phone Overnight
supporting_text: Sleep Focus silences notifications on a schedule, so your phone stays calm while you rest.
caption:
⚡ TODAY’S 30-SECOND TECH WIN

Does your phone buzz all night with notifications you don’t need until morning?

A Sleep Focus can quietly hold most alerts until you’re ready to see them.

Open Settings, tap Focus, choose Sleep, then set a schedule that matches your bedtime.

Your calls and messages are still there in the morning, just without the overnight noise.

Save this tip for later.

Follow @DigitalCalmDaily for one simple 30-Second Tech Win every day.

reel_steps: Set a start and end time
